dsp GenChipPulse25NoteSlideDown where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.002 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + slA * 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let w := select(lt(ph, 0.25 + colour * 0.1), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.6444

  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0

  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0

dsp GenChipPulse25SwellSlideUp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))

    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 - slA * 0.5 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let w := select(lt(ph, 0.25 + colour * 0.1), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.6446

dsp GenChipPulse50BlipPlain where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.15 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let w := select(lt(ph, 0.5 + colour * 0.1), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.6537

dsp GenChipPulse50BlipSlideDown where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.15 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + slA * 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let w := select(lt(ph, 0.5 + colour * 0.1), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.6537

dsp GenChipPulse50NoteVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.002 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.012
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let w := select(lt(ph, 0.5 + colour * 0.1), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.6444

dsp GenChipPulse50SwellPlain where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let w := select(lt(ph, 0.5 + colour * 0.1), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.6446

dsp GenChipPulse50SwellSlideUp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 - slA * 0.5 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let w := select(lt(ph, 0.5 + colour * 0.1), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.6446

dsp GenChipTriangle4bitBlipVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.15 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.012
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let w := quant(1.0 - abs(ph * 4.0 - 2.0), 8.0)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 1.0009

dsp GenChipTriangle4bitBlipSlideDown where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.15 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + slA * 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let w := quant(1.0 - abs(ph * 4.0 - 2.0), 8.0)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 1.0166

dsp GenChipTriangle4bitNoteVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.002 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.012
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let w := quant(1.0 - abs(ph * 4.0 - 2.0), 8.0)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.9661

dsp GenChipTriangle4bitSwellPlain where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let w := quant(1.0 - abs(ph * 4.0 - 2.0), 8.0)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.9954

dsp GenChipTriangle4bitSwellSlideUp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 - slA * 0.5 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let w := quant(1.0 - abs(ph * 4.0 - 2.0), 8.0)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.9952

dsp GenChipTriangle4bitSwellSlideDown where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + slA * 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let w := quant(1.0 - abs(ph * 4.0 - 2.0), 8.0)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.9954

dsp GenChipNoiseShortBlipVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.15 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.012
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let heldA := select(lt(ph, 0.07), noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339), held)
    set held := heldA
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let w := heldA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.9013

dsp GenChipNoiseShortNotePlain where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.002 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))

    set held := heldA
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let w := heldA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.6868

dsp GenChipNoiseShortNoteSlideUp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.002 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 - slA * 0.5 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let heldA := select(lt(ph, 0.07), noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339), held)
    set held := heldA
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let w := heldA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.6872

dsp GenChipNoiseShortSwellVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.012
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let heldA := select(lt(ph, 0.07), noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339), held)
    set held := heldA
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let w := heldA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.7185

dsp GenChipNoiseShortSwellSlideUp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 - slA * 0.5 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let heldA := select(lt(ph, 0.07), noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339), held)
    set held := heldA
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let w := heldA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.6929
